# ci/untrusted-checkout

Pull request code run in a privileged workflow.

A pull_request_target, workflow_run, or issue_comment workflow (or a reusable workflow one of them calls) that checks out the pull request head (head.sha, head.ref, refs/pull/N/merge, workflow_run.head_sha) and then installs dependencies, builds, runs scripts, or uses a local action from it in the same job.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: block; warn when the job waits for approval (a label, author_association, or actor check, a deployment environment, or a job it needs that checks permissions or membership), and for workflows outside the repository root .github/workflows. Jobs limited to same-repository or merged pull requests, and workflow_run workflows triggered only by workflows without pull request events, are skipped.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html), [CWE-94](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/94.html), OWASP A03:2025, <https://securitylab.github.com/resources/github-actions-preventing-pwn-requests/>.

## Why it matters

These workflows run with the base repository's secrets and a token that can write to it. Install scripts, build scripts, and local actions in the pull request run with that access, so anyone who opens a pull request can steal the secrets or push to the repository.

## Flagged

`.github/workflows/comment-ops.yml` (block):

```yaml
gh pr checkout ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
```

`.github/workflows/coverage.yml` (block):

```yaml
ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
```

`.github/workflows/fork-branch.yml` (block):

```yaml
repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
```

`.github/workflows/gated.yml` (warn):

```yaml
ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
```

`.github/workflows/preview.yml` (block):

```yaml
ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/merge
```

## Not flagged

- `- run: npm ci && npm test` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: pull_request workflows run without secrets
- `- run: gh pr view ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --json title` in `.github/workflows/comment-ops.yml`: reads metadata only, checks nothing out
- `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}` in `.github/workflows/fork-branch.yml`: a branch name alone is looked up in the base repository, where forks cannot push
- `ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}` in `.github/workflows/fork-branch.yml`: the head is only picked for pull_request events, which run without secrets
- `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` in `.github/workflows/fork-branch.yml`: only a published tool is installed and it reads the files
- `- uses: actions/checkout@v4` in `.github/workflows/preview.yml`: the base branch, which this workflow trusts
- `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` in `.github/workflows/preview.yml`: checked out into pr/ and only read as data
- `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}` in `.github/workflows/preview.yml`: the job only runs for branches of this repository
- `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` in `.github/workflows/preview.yml`: nothing from the checkout runs
- `ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}` in `.github/workflows/release-notes.yml`: the Release workflow runs only on tag pushes

## How to fix

Build and test pull request code in a pull_request workflow without secrets, and pass results to the privileged workflow as artifacts; if you must check out the head here, do not run anything from it.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore ci/untrusted-checkout: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "ci/untrusted-checkout": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
